posts.author: Redfixcoolio
posts.body: Hello Rpg Makers! I'm a basic Maker working on a mod for Rpg maker 2003 and I wanted to know if anyone knows about this weird thing that happening. I want to make a tileset by changing the pixels in the World File in Resouce manager and whenever I change it; some pixels become Black! I dont know what I'm doing but I hope anybody whose reading this can help me out. Btw I'm broke so anybody hating out there dont make fun of me of picking Rpg maker 2003.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
RM2003 has the most powerful and advanced eventing engine of all RPG Makers (even more so when extended with Maniacs Patch) so no reason to make fun of anyone anyway
As for your question: how do you do the editing, with what program? Are you sure the file gets saved with the correct palette and transparent color?

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
MS Paint is not a good tool for this. I can recommend
https://graphicsgale.com/
(free)

posts.author: Akkari
posts.body:
On top of graphics gale, there is also GrafX2 if you want something similar to Amiga programs like Deluxe Paint and Brilliance:
http://grafx2.chez.com/
Paid software options include Pro Motion NG(what I use, inspired by Deluxe Paint) and Aseprite(popular amongst the wider indie scene, also it can be free if you decide to compile it yourself).
